hook: Genomes of five Gulf of Mexico deep-sea species show small populations and declining diversity
hook_turn: show small populations and declining diversity
summary: The twilight zone of the deep ocean has little conservation data. Genomic samples from 2011 to 2023 gave effective population sizes below viability thresholds, falling diversity in some species, and niche models predicting shrinking habitat. It covers five species in one gulf, so the broader crisis is a possibility rather than shown.
title: Extinction risks in deep-sea populations revealed by genomic data and ecological niche modeling.
